name: Sunken Temple: Jammal'an's forcefield stays closed until the Hakkar event, the hallway is clear (#7689)
contract: #7689: on Ascension the Dungeon Finder start in the north hallway (#8527) had no enemies, and killing
the Avatar of Hakkar (8443) opened the way to the troll boss Jammal'an. The forcefield (149431) no longer opens
when it spawns: it stays closed in a new instance until the Avatar's death sets the Hakkar event (instance data 2)
to DONE. The nine Nightmare dragonkin of that hallway (spawns 33714-33719, 33721-33723) are gone: none of the four
entries is within 60 yd of the start, and at the hallway's west end only the main hall's whelps 37-60 yd away remain.
